crossRefs.note: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.
Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;
those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.
They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips.
There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and…
“They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood. They have grown strong in the land, but not for truth; for they…
“Everyone beware of his neighbor, and don’t trust in any brother; for every brother will utterly supplant, and every…
Then they said, “Come! Let’s devise plans against Jeremiah; for the law won’t perish from the priest, nor counsel from…
Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him…
Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”
After five days, the high priest, Ananias, came down with certain elders and an orator, one Tertullus. They informed…
For we have found this man to be a plague, an instigator of insurrections among all the Jews throughout the world, and…
I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, “Now the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of…
My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows…
Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”
There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.
for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying…
Deliver my soul, Yahweh, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully…
For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.

translations.web: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
translations.bsb: Your tongue devises destruction like a sharpened razor, O worker of deceit.
translations.kjv: Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
translations.asv: Thy tongue deviseth very wickedness, Like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
